reserveReview.rationale: William Buck ASRS 4400 report as of 31 October 2026 23:59 UTC, signed 10 November 2026: AUD 770,500.92 at Banking Circle and AUD 8,442,977.86 at Westpac under the AMAL bare trust, both expressly 100% cash, total AUD 9,213,478.78. Percentages derive without favourable rounding from those amounts and the complete reserve denominator. Page 4 states 9,088,311.70 AUDD across nine networks, including 10.00 on ARC, while the individual displayed chain amounts sum to 9,088,311.69; the one-cent reported-total difference is retained, not silently treated as exact equality. Reserves exceed reported liabilities by AUD 125,167.08 (101.38% coverage). The procedures agree account statements and chain confirmations without exception, but expressly provide no assurance opinion and have no independence requirement. Exact institution source keys match the existing adapter; the report does not disclose deposit tenor or reserve-wide insolvency/rehypothecation protections.
